entries.description: 1 uF X7R ceramic capacitor, 0603 / 1608 metric, 35 V, +/-10%, paper tape on 180 mm reel
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Production in manufacturer product record and TDK Meister 2025.12 parts list; reconfirm when purchasing.
entries.open_items: Nominal capacitance and geometry unchanged; rating raised from 10 V. C1 is on VBUS; C2/C23/C24 are on 3.3 V. Exact-part DC-bias characterization is linked but numerical values at 5 V/5.5 V and 3.3 V were not obtained. C1/C2 require more than 0.47 uF effective at regulator pins after bias, tolerance, temperature and aging. Existing IPC lands differ from manufacturer reflow recommendations; assembler process approval remains open.

entries.description: 100 nF X7R ceramic capacitor, 0603 / 1608 metric, 50 V, +/-10%, paper tape on 180 mm reel
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Production in manufacturer product record and TDK Meister 2025.12 parts list; reconfirm when purchasing.
entries.open_items: Nominal capacitance and geometry unchanged; rating raised from 10 V. Voltage stress is 6.6% of rating at 3.3 V. Biased capacitance not numerically qualified. Verify decoupling and NRST response on first board. Existing IPC lands differ from manufacturer reflow recommendations; assembler process approval remains open.

entries.description: 4.7 uF X7R(Murata) ceramic capacitor, 0603 / 1608 metric, 16 V, +/-10%, D suffix 180 mm paper-tape reel
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact D suffix exists in manufacturer product record and reference sheet. An explicit lifecycle commitment and live distributor stock were not established.
entries.open_items: Nominal capacitance and geometry unchanged; rating raised from 10 V. X7R(Murata) uses a temperature characteristic evaluated with half-rated DC bias, not the ordinary EIA X7R condition. Record exact-part effective capacitance at 3.3 V before final qualification. The compact schematic value omits the dielectric, which remains mandatory in this purchasing description.

entries.description: 5.1 kohm precision thick-film resistor, 0603, +/-1%, 0.1 W at 70 C, +/-100 ppm/K, V suffix paper tape
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact part appears in manufacturer's current model catalog; no stock or lifetime-supply guarantee inferred.
entries.open_items: USB CC pull-downs. At a conservative 5.5 V across each resistor and -1% R, power is 5.99 mW versus 100 mW at 70 C. Initial resistance is 5.049 to 5.151 kohm. Temperature, aging and assembled USB attach behavior remain additional checks.

entries.description: 10 kohm precision thick-film resistor, 0603, +/-1%, 0.1 W at 70 C, +/-100 ppm/K, V suffix paper tape
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact part appears in manufacturer's current model catalog; no stock or lifetime-supply guarantee inferred.
entries.open_items: Nominal resistance unchanged; tolerance explicitly fixed to 1%. At 3.6 V and -1% R, power is 1.31 mW. Functional reset, button and driver configuration checks remain first-board tasks.

entries.description: 2.2 kohm precision thick-film resistor, 0603, +/-1%, 0.1 W at 70 C, +/-100 ppm/K, V suffix paper tape
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact part appears in manufacturer's current model catalog; no stock or lifetime-supply guarantee inferred.
entries.open_items: I2C pull-ups. At 3.6 V and -1% R, power is 5.95 mW. Lowest DC working-voltage screening bound sqrt(0.1 W * 2178 ohm) is 14.8 V. Board bus capacitance, sink level and rise/fall timing must be measured.

entries.description: 100 kohm precision thick-film resistor, 0603, +/-1%, 0.1 W at 70 C, +/-100 ppm/K, V suffix paper tape
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact part appears in manufacturer's current model catalog; no stock or lifetime-supply guarantee inferred.
entries.open_items: LED_EN pull-down. At 3.6 V and -1% R, power is 0.131 mW. Verify the display remains off through reset and power ramps on first board.

entries.description: 20 kohm precision thick-film resistor, 0603, +/-1%, 0.1 W at 70 C, +/-100 ppm/K, V suffix paper tape
entries.lifecycle_evidence: Exact part appears in manufacturer's current model catalog; no stock or lifetime-supply guarantee inferred.
entries.open_items: LED-driver current-setting resistor. At a conservative 3.6 V across it and -1% R, power is 0.655 mW. Initial R range 19.8 to 20.2 kohm adds about -0.99%/+1.01% to inverse-R current variation before driver, temperature and aging tolerances. Verify channel current and supply load on first board.

entries.description: Unpopulated NFC tuning position; not a purchasing line item
entries.open_items: Do not order or fit a guessed capacitance. Select an exact C0G part only after measuring the assembled antenna/tag resonance and read range.
